run_pick_and_place_evaluation: run the pick and place agent evaluation loop with a Stretch robot in a real-world environment
test_pick_skill: test the pick skill in isolation by passing the --test-pick flag to skip gaze and place steps
test_gaze_skill: test the gaze skill in isolation by passing the --test-gaze flag to skip pick and place steps
test_place_skill: test the place skill by passing the --test-place flag to evaluate placement behavior
visualize_robot_observations: visualize robot camera observations during the evaluation loop by passing the --show-observations flag
